title: GUIWindow.gif — picture of "The AWT Components" window, from the lesson page "AWT Components" (trail: Creating a User Interface / Overview of the Java UI), The Java Tutorial

program_depicted.name: GUIWindow (example program, class GUIWindow extends java.awt.Frame; window title set by window.setTitle("The AWT Components"))
program_depicted.toolkit: java.awt (Abstract Window Toolkit). Components visible: Menu bar, Canvas, Label, TextArea, List, TextField, Button, Checkbox, Choice. No Swing/JFC class exists in the program.
program_depicted.evidence: evidence/source-pages/princeton-spring96/GUIWindow.java lines 19-107 (same mirror, same directory date as the image)
program_depicted.jdk_version: Not stated for the capture. The program uses the JDK 1.0 AWT event model (action()/ACTION_EVENT); the hosting copy is dated 26 Feb 1996, one month after JDK 1.0 (23 Jan 1996). Treat as JDK 1.0-era (1.0 or late beta); exact runtime and browser/appletviewer build unknown.
program_depicted.platform: Not stated for this image. The window decoration is X11/Motif-style, but platform is NOT asserted from appearance. The same page states its separate FileDialog picture comes from "the Solaris Applet Viewer"; that statement does not name the platform of GUIWindow.gif.
